code:
CSV / JSON (row-oriented):
  need 3 of 20 columns -> still read all 20

Parquet (columnar):
  need 3 of 20 columns -> read only those 3

Narrow queries on wide tables save the most.
caption: Columnar storage reads only the columns a query actually needs.
